```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 3
#| fig-subcap: 
#|   - This
#|   - is a
#|   - test
x <- c(1:100)
y <- x+x+2
plot(x, y)
hist(y, breaks=5)
barplot(table(x,y))
```

In PDF, all subcaps start with `a)`.
